learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the vibrant colors, romantic poetry, and deep devotion of the Rajput courts through their breathtaking miniature paintings!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Rajasthani artists did something amazing: they painted music! 'Ragamala' paintings are visual representations of Indian musical modes (Ragas), showing the mood, time of day, and season of the music.

The central theme of Rajasthani art is the romantic and divine love of Radha and Krishna. They also painted 'Nayak-Nayika Bheda' (different types of heroes and heroines in love) based on poetic texts.

Rajasthan is huge, so different kingdoms developed their own styles. Mewar used bold reds and yellows. Bundi is famous for lush greenery and rain. Kishangarh is famous for elegant, elongated facial features.

main_concepts.concept_title: 👸 The Mona Lisa of India: Bani Thani
main_concepts.simple_explanation: From the Kishangarh school, artist Nihal Chand painted 'Bani Thani', depicting Radha with a sharp nose, thin lips, and elongated lotus-like eyes. It is the most famous Rajasthani painting.

fun_activity.title: 👤 The Perfect Profile
fun_activity.instructions: Rajasthani faces are almost always drawn in strict profile (side view). Try drawing a friend's face entirely from the side. Emphasize a sharp nose and a large, expressive, lotus-shaped eye!

exam_tips: 📌 Match the painting to the school: 'Maru Ragini' -> Mewar, 'Radha (Bani Thani)' -> Kishangarh, 'Chaugan Players' -> Jodhpur.
📌 Remember the key artists: Sahibdin (Mewar) and Nihal Chand (Kishangarh). They are highly tested in MCQs.
📌 Describe Rajasthani art as deeply rooted in Indian literature, poetry (Bhakti movement), and music.
quick_recap: ⭐ Rajasthani art uses bold, primary colors and paints faces in profile.
⭐ Radha and Krishna are the ultimate heroes of these paintings.
⭐ Kishangarh's Bani Thani is characterized by highly exaggerated, elegant facial features.
